initial_noise_scope: Same RNG seeds and update seeds. UNet/DiT share volumetric noise shape; Tensor-DiT uses latent-space noise of a different shape.
scope: Matched validation evaluation of old UNet best epsilon weights and repaired epoch100 v models. This compares these fitted pipelines, not architecture alone or held-out-test performance.
statistical_unit: 44 cases; average sampling seeds within each case. Three training seeds reported separately; pooled intervals average fitted models within case and do not cover training-seed uncertainty. No multiplicity correction.
